page.overview:
Who is Michelangelo?

Michelangelo is the main protagonist of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Last Ronin, carrying on after his three brothers had died. He seeks to avenge the murders of his brothers, said to be the work of Oroku Hiroto, the grandson of .

Michelangelo is no longer as cheerful, jokey, immature, optimistic and social as he used to be, now more distant, mature, serious, cautious, reflective, cold, etc. He was greatly affected by the death of his family and friends, especially that of his brothers, and moved heaven and earth for justice to be done by killing Oroku Hiroto. He became desperate and determined at the same time, as evidenced by the risks ready to take to achieve it and having difficulty in moving forward and continuing to the point of committing suicide (luckily, it was narrowly avoided by fainting as a result of a blood loss).

He misses all those he cared about, his family even more. He always brings their masks, weapons, and 's book as a keepsake to achieve justice.

Getting to see old friends who were still alive, like April, had a positive impact on him, making him remember that no one is ever alone as well as rekindling hope and meaning in his life and awakening little of his old self. Michelangelo befriends Casey Marie Jones early on, seeing a lot through her of her father's traits and later on becomes her sensei (somewhat thanks to ).

Also known as: Mikey, Michelangelo turtle.
